image_description: A guenon monkey (likely a Green Monkey or Vervet) sitting on a horizontal wooden beam. The monkey has olive-green fur on its back, a white chest and facial ruff, and a black face with white eyebrows. It is facing left. A thick rope hangs in the upper left foreground. The background is a blurred green mesh fence.
